metadata.title: Secure Storage Operations Composite Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines how storage security patterns operate together as a governed, observable, and escalation-aware system, without collapsing data governance, security operations, or platform responsibilities.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability responsible for operating shared infrastructure platforms in a manner that preserves confidentiality, integrity, availability, and accountability.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composes storage security patterns into a coherent operational system that exposes assurance signals and escalates violations without performing response or governance actions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Establishes the need for data-centric protection, lifecycle traceability, and escalation of violations independent of application or platform context.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines integration points between security operations and platform-generated evidentiary signals, without allowing platform systems to initiate incident response.

components.title: Storage Core Security Binding
components.description: Ensures storage-enforced confidentiality and protection guarantees remain continuously active and verifiable.

components.title: Storage Access Mediation Binding
components.description: Ensures all access to stored data remains explicitly mediated and attributable.

components.title: Storage Integrity & Immutability Binding
components.description: Ensures stored data remains trustworthy, non-repudiable, and resistant to tampering or silent destruction.

components.title: Storage Lifecycle & Retention Binding
components.description: Ensures authoritative control over data lifespan, preservation, and deletion.

components.title: Storage Telemetry & Audit Binding
components.description: Ensures storage behavior is observable, evidentiary, and consumable by governance and security operations.
